incident_time: 19:12 Title Decision - Qualifying SC2-SC1 Times Description Decision - Qualifying SC2-SC1 Times Enclosed ESP DOC 50 - Qualifying SC2-SC1 Times.pdf Felix Holter Natalie Corsmit Mathieu Remmerie Derek Warwick David Domingo 2026 SPANISH GRAND PRIX 11 – 13 September 2026 From The Stewards Document 50 To All Officials, All Teams Date 12 September 2026 Time 19:12 The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Alleged breach of Article B1.8.5 of the FIA F1 Regulations and Article 12.2.1.i of the FIA International Sporting Code (non-compliance with the Race Director's Competition Notes, item 1, document 28).
reason: The Stewards thoroughly reviewed Marshalling/Positioning data, timing data, on-board cameras and CCTV cameras. All drivers concerned stayed at or above speeds necessary to stay below 1:42.0 around the vast majority of the circuit. However, in all cases the Stewards determined that the drivers took appropriate drivers to pass while giving those drivers a clear track. The Stewards therefore determine that all drivers concerned did not drive "unnecessarily slowly", and that they were above the maximum time because they took appropriate steps, and we therefore take no further action.
